svg.title: Evidence has different boundaries
svg.desc: Native Figma facts, short intent tags and structured bridge metadata supply design and contract evidence for two distinct paths. A source check reports only declared rules in the selected scope. Implementation and runtime QA supply separate evidence for complete tasks; no single check establishes WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
